fomod.Name: Devotion - Quest Mod Patches
fomod.Author: Devotion (PDV)
fomod.Description:
Per-mod Devotion patches for quest mods, plus the Authoria ARR 2.5 non-quest compatibility lane. Each quest patch teaches Devotion how the gods react to a quest mod's outcomes: piety awards keyed to the quest stage the player actually reaches, swept across every deity and Prince whose likes/dislikes profile validly reacts.
Two lanes: an Authoria all-in-one package (one combined plugin), or individual per-mod patches that auto-select against your load order.
Requires: Devotion (PlayerDevotion) with per-mod channel support.
Proof state: records, scripts, and matrix channels are machine-verified. In-game runtime proof is pending; this package is experimental, not supported. See the bundled runbook and structured evidence ledgers.
